/// Closed metadata wire model; source content and approval state are absent.
/// Closed exact-byte pin for one explicitly indexed resource.
/// Complete unretained proposal consumed atomically by the root-owned Store seam.
/// Ordered private captures and public pins assembled without mutating a Store.

limits: Stdlib physical line observations only; no branch or whole-body coverage.

The native companion has10positive entries in the actual native trace and0in the historical mock-only trace; their explicit union is used here.
No thread trace hooks; worker-thread functions remain unobserved.
